rationale: Directly reuses the adjacent .claude/ copytree pattern in setup_worktree; small self-contained change with isolated test impact. Option B has no precedent for filesystem checks at config-load time anywhere in config/, needs new plumbing to thread project_root into from_dict(), and introduces environment-dependent config validity.
rule: Option A: support directories via shutil.copytree(dirs_exist_ok=True), mirroring the .claude/ path
alternatives_rejected: Option B: validate and reject worktree_copy_files directory entries at config load time
